appearanceSource: The reused editorial portrait depicts a savanna elephant. The printed Gore action supports the tusks.
habitatSource: Grassland is tagged in the official legacy listing at https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/16855-elephant. Savannas and open woodlands are editorial habitat tags. The print stat block lists no habitat.

officialCorrection: Errata v2.0, p. 1, updates Monster Manual p. 322 Gore from 18 (3d8 + 5) to 19 (3d8 + 6) and Stomp from 21 (3d10 + 5) to 22 (3d10 + 6). The save DC and hit bonuses are unchanged.
